events.name: Bash
events.head: Check container, creds file, tracker log, git state
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; timeout 20 docker ps --filter name=tantra-mongo --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}' 2>&1; timeout 10 docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}} {{range .Mounts}}{{.Name}}:{{.Destination}} {{end}} {{.Config.Cmd}}' tantra-mongo 2>&1; stat -f '%Sp' ~/.config/tantra/mongo.env; grep -o '^[A-Z_]*=' ~/.config/tantra/mongo.env; grep -c 'MongoDB written' ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log; grep -E 'MongoDB|Traceback|HTTP Error|sync (ok|done)|exit' ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log | tail -5; tail -3 ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log | cut -c

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check docker and recent tracker runs
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; date; ls -l ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log; docker ps --filter name=tantra-mongo --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}} {{.Ports}}' 2>&1 | head -3; docker inspect -f '{{.HostConfig.RestartPolicy.Name}} {{range .Mounts}}{{.Name}}:{{.Destination}} {{end}} {{.Config.Cmd}}' tantra-mongo 2>&1|head -2; launchctl list | grep -i tantra.tracker; grep -n -i 'synced\|^20' ~/Library/Logs/tantra-tracker.log | tail -4 | cut -c1-160
